# dsh-phone
Use DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) from your phone. Scan a QR code in `dsh web`, sign in to OpenTandem on
the phone, tap **Allow**, and send tasks to the computer that runs `dsh`. Your existing `dsh` sessio
ns show up on the phone, and the phone and the computer continue the same session.

You can also open **Plugins → Add plugin** in `dsh web`, enter `dsh-phone`, install it and press **E
nable now**. If the **Phone** entry does not appear in the sidebar, refresh the page once.
## Use
1. Click **Phone** in the `dsh web` sidebar and press **Show QR code**.
2. Scan the code with your phone and open it in the browser.
3. Sign in to OpenTandem on the phone and tap **Allow**.
4. The page in `dsh web` shows that the computer is connected.
5. Open OpenTandem on the phone. The project folders that `dsh` uses and their recent sessions are a
dded to the task list, and you can continue them or start new ones.
To connect another account, press **Switch account** on the page. The current connection stays until
you tap **Allow** on the phone.
## What it installs and sends
This plugin is a small page and a pairing step. The part that keeps the phone connected is the OpenT
andem command line, which is a separate program, so you should know what it does before you press **

| What | Details |
| Download | The first time, the plugin downloads the launcher from `https://opentandem.org/api/cli-
script?file=launcher.mjs` to `~/.opentandem-dsh/` and runs it on the Node.js that runs `dsh`. The la

uncher installs the OpenTandem command line, which takes about a minute. |
| Background service | Th
e command line starts a background Runner that stays installed, so the phone can reach this computer
after `dsh web` is closed. Remove it with `opentandem uninstall`, or remove the computer in the Ope

nTandem settings. |
| What the phone can do | After you tap **Allow**, tasks sent from that OpenTand
em account run on this computer through `dsh`. Allow it only if you started the pairing yourself. |
| Accounts | You sign in on the phone, so this plugin never sees your OpenTandem account or password

. It does not use your DeepSeek account. Tasks use the models you have already set up in `dsh`. |
|
Connection check | Every route of this plugin sits behind the connection check that `dsh` uses for i
ts own APIs, and the POST routes only accept `application/json`. |
The source of the OpenTandem Runner and command line is public under AGPL-3.0.

## Compatibility
This plugin has been tested on macOS with `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1. Windows and Linux have no
en tested on macOS with `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1. Windows and Linux have not been tested yet.
## About OpenTandem
**OpenTandem is a unified workspace for individuals and teams that manages multiple AI coding agents

, with mobile access.**
**One workspace, all your machines, with agent switching, model routing, liv
e quota tracking, and team collaboration.**

MIT. The OpenTandem command line and Runner are separate AGPL-3.0 programs that this plugin only sta
rts as a child process, and none of their code is bundled here.
